question: Which gene is most frequently associated with acquired mutations in breast cancer?
analysis: The p53 gene is the most frequently mutated gene in breast cancer. While BRCA1 and BRCA2 are well-known for their role in hereditary breast cancer, p53 mutations are more common in sporadic cases of breast cancer. Her2/neu is often amplified in breast cancer, but it is not a gene typically associated with acquired mutations in the same context as p53.
